SELECT zhid, zhmc, pym, bbzl, gzl, sfbz, qybz, bqys, yssm FROM bgxt_xmzh_zb WHERE 1=1
AND zhid IN (SELECT zhid FROM bgxt_yqxmzh WHERE sb_djid = #{sbDjid})
AND (zhmc LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%') OR pym LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%'))

AND (zhmc LIKE CONCAT('%',#{name},'%') OR pym LIKE CONCAT('%',#{name},'%'))
ORDER BY zhid LIMIT 50
